translations.translatedText: # Monday 4.7.2022
3 dead in a shooting in Copenhagen. SAS pilots on strike. Heating of small houses. Women in listed companies. Currency exchange. Tax refunds. The weather.
The TV's Clear News has a summer break from 6.6. to 12.8.
Read and listen to the radio broadcast here.
## Shooting in Copenhagen

![Flowers and candles began to gather at a Copenhagen shopping centre on Monday, the day after the mass shooting.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_9248,h_5202,x_0,y_1153/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-97787562c2bd5abc57f/1656930006)
Open image viewer
Flowers and candles began to gather at a Copenhagen shopping centre on Monday, the day after the mass shooting. Photo: Kirsi Heikel / Yle
3 people have died in the shooting at a shopping centre in Copenhagen, Denmark. 4 people are in hospital with serious injuries.
The incident happened south of Copenhagen's city centre on Sunday evening.
The police said in the morning that the investigation has not found signs of terrorism.
The 22-year-old suspect has been arrested. He is a native Dane.
## SAS pilots' strike

![SAS airline Airbus A320 aircraft parked at the airport in Copenhagen.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1920,h_1080,x_0,y_56/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-97729762bfa1173ea0e/1658214821)
Open image viewer
Illustrative photo. SAS airline Airbus A320 aircraft at Kastrup airport in Copenhagen in March 2020. Photo: Johan Nilsson / AFP
The pilots of the airline SAS have started a strike. The parties to the labour dispute have not reached agreement.
Almost 1000 pilots from Sweden, Denmark and Norway intend to take part in the industrial action.
SAS estimates that about half of the flights will be cancelled. The strike affects 30,000 passengers a day.
SAS's flights to Finland continue normally, because the flights are operated by an external partner company.
## Fossil heating methods
![Oil heating boiler](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-5845738)
Open image viewer
Oil heating boiler. Photo: Mika Kanerva / YLE
The state gives money to those who give up fossil heating in a detached house.
40 million extra euros will be added to the state budget for giving up oil heating or gas heating. The subsidies are enough for a total of 33,000 detached houses.
Over 23,000 people who switched from oil heating have applied for subsidy since the year before last.
## Women in listed companies
![Women on the boards of listed companies.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9943977)
Open image viewer
The number of women on the boards of listed companies has begun to rise. Photo: Pekka Sipilä / Yle
The number of women on the boards of listed companies has risen to a record level, 31 percent.
In large listed companies the share of women rose to 35 percent. On the boards of medium-sized listed companies there were 32 percent women, and in small companies 26 percent.
## Currency exchange
![Dollars in a steel service urn of a currency exchange point.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-5289995)
Open image viewer
A lot of US dollars are exchanged. Forex does not sell or buy Russian roubles. Ukrainian currency also could not be exchanged. Photo: Yle
The demand for travel currencies has risen as corona restrictions have eased.
For example, the currency exchange company Forex says that the exchange of foreign money has nearly increased tenfold from last year.
You can prepare for small purchases and disruptions in card payments with cash.
For example, at Helsinki railway station, at Forex's exchange point, there are sometimes queues.
The most exchanged currencies are the Nordic crowns, British pounds and US dollars.
## Tax refunds
![Tax letter](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10553706)
Open image viewer
Photo: Vesa Moilanen / Lehtikuva
The first tax refunds have come into bank accounts today.
Over 180,000 customers will receive tax refunds this month, totalling 170 million euros.
The most tax refunds are paid in August. The last tax refunds are paid in December.
## The weather
![weather map](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12523129)
Open image viewer
Photo: Yle
The weather starts to cool.
On Tuesday showers will come across almost the whole country. In the west the temperature stays around 20 degrees, in the east there are still heat readings.
